name: The Long Siege
about: A warlike house besieges a loyal lord's seat, and the walls can only hold so long. March the royal host to break the siege, pay to keep the walls standing, or talk terms and give ground. If the town falls, its conqueror looks to Kingsmere next.
title: The Siege of {keep}

beats.speaker: holder
beats.text: {besieger.house}'s banners come over the hills at dawn and keep coming until they surround {keep}. By nightfall there are trenches, and by the end of the week, a trebuchet.

court.text: A rider from {holder} of {holder.house}, half dead from the road: "My lord holds {keep} for the crown, Your Grace. The walls will last a season, maybe two. Not three."

options.label: March the royal host to save {keep}
options.result: The royal host marches out of Kingsmere under the King's banner, on the road to {keep}.

options.label: Smuggle gold and grain into {keep} (250 gold)
options.result: Barges of grain and sacks of silver slip into {keep} through the water gate at night.

options.label: Call {besieger} to talks
options.result: The King's herald rides through the siege lines under a white flag to {besieger}'s tent.

beats.speaker: holder
beats.text: {keep} eats its horses, then its dogs. The trebuchet knocks down the chapel tower, so {holder} has the bells hung in the gatehouse where they can still ring.

court.text: {holder}, in a letter tied to an arrow: "We have a month, Your Grace. After that I open the gates, or my people start eating each other."

options.label: March the royal host now
options.result: The royal host marches through the night. At dawn the defenders see the King's banner on the hill, and ring every bell they have left.

options.label: Tell {holder} to surrender {keep} on terms
options.hint: {holder.houseName} −30 · the town is lost, but the war ends
options.result: On the King's order, {holder} opens the gates of {keep} and walks out with {holder.his} sword turned down in surrender.

beats.speaker: besieger
beats.text: In {besieger}'s tent, with the trebuchet still firing outside, {besieger} names a price for ending the siege: {keep} itself, and a seat on the King's council.

court.text: {besieger} of {besieger.house}: "Give me {keep}, Your Grace, and you'll have no truer friend in the realm. Refuse, and I'll take it anyway, and I won't forget that you refused."

options.label: Give {keep} to {besieger}
options.result: The King's seal gives {keep} to {besieger.house}. {holder} is offered a pension, and spits on it.

options.label: Pay them to lift the siege (400 gold)
options.result: {besieger} takes the gold, burns the trebuchet and marches home whistling.

options.label: Refuse, and march
options.result: The herald rides back. The royal host is already on the road behind him.

beats.speaker: holder
beats.text: The royal host and the besiegers clash in the trenches below {keep}'s walls. The defenders charge out to join in, and for a day the mud is so thick nobody can tell whose banner is whose.

beats.speaker: besieger
beats.text: At last the ram breaks {keep}'s gate. {besieger.house}'s men pour into the streets, and {besieger} stands on the broken walls, looking toward Kingsmere.

court.text: {besieger}, from {keep}'s own hall: "I took {keep} with the sword, Your Grace. Make it mine by law, and my sword is yours."

options.label: Accept the conquest
options.result: The King names {besieger} lord of {keep}. {holder} goes into the hills with what is left of {holder.his} household.

options.label: Demand {keep} back, by force if needed
options.result: The King's answer is one line: {keep} belongs to the crown's friend. {besieger} laughs and reads it out to {besieger.his} captains.

beats.speaker: besieger
beats.text: Fresh from taking {keep}, {besieger} turns the siege engines toward Kingsmere. If one royal town's walls broke, another's can too.

beats.speaker: holder
beats.text: The besiegers' camp below {keep} is empty except for crows and a burned trebuchet. {holder} rings the gatehouse bells for a whole day, then has them hung back in the chapel.

beats.speaker: besieger
beats.text: {keep} flies {besieger.house}'s banner now, and the war is over. The crown kept its throne by handing a friend's town to an enemy, and every lord in the realm has noticed.
